title: web UI: light theme support for plain-browser users
description: app.css hardcodes color-scheme: dark with dark fallback values, so outside the VS Code webview the UI is always dark. Respect prefers-color-scheme with a proper light palette and add a manual theme toggle persisted in localStorage (like the existing sort/group/show-closed prefs). Keep the VS Code theme variables taking precedence when running inside the extension.
